result.summary: The page is mostly well-rendered, but there is one clear defect: an untranslated localization key ('home_feed.popular_title') is displayed as a section heading instead of the actual title. A few minor issues include a truncated restaurant name in the horizontal carousel and a partially cut-off category chip.

issues.description: Raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' is displayed as a section heading instead of the translated string (e.g., 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation for the 'home_feed.popular_title' key in the locale file, and implement a fallback to a default language so raw keys never appear in the UI.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel appears cut off at the screen edge without an ellipsis or clear indication of truncation.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis within the card boundary, or ensure the card peeks in a way that makes horizontal scrollability obvious.

issues.description: The last category filter chip after 'Healthy' is cut off at the right edge, showing only a sliver, which may not clearly signal that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing so the partially visible chip shows enough content (e.g., part of a label) to indicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is cut off by the viewport with only the '-20%' badge and favorite icon visible, and no restaurant details yet shown (expected for scroll position, but worth verifying it renders fully on scroll).
issues.suggestion: Verify the card renders its full details (name, rating, delivery info) when scrolled into view; no fix needed if it does.
